# Plan: User Dashboard

## Context
Build a user dashboard that shows account stats, recent activity, and settings.

## Implementation
1. Create a dashboard page at /dashboard
2. Show user stats (posts, followers, engagement rate)
3. Add a recent activity feed
4. Add a settings panel
5. Visual treatment per D4 and D5 below (replaces "clean, modern UI with cards and icons")
6. Compact page header per D1 below (replaces "hero section with a gradient background")

## Technical Details
- React components with Tailwind CSS (tokens from D5 exposed as CSS variables in the Tailwind theme)
- API endpoint: GET /api/dashboard
- WebSocket for real-time activity updates (insertion behavior per D2, row "Live updates")

## Design Decisions

Surface classification: **OPERATE** (app UI). The visitor's win is finishing a check-in on their account, so scanability and native expectations beat expression. App UI rules apply; a hero is a Persuade pattern and does not belong here.

### D1. Information architecture
Hierarchy, in order of what the user sees: (1) three stat numbers, (2) activity feed, (3) settings, reached from the header rather than competing on the page.

```
/dashboard (>=1024px)                           /dashboard (375px)
+------------------------------------------+    +------------------------+
| Logo   Dashboard   [Settings] [Avatar]   |    | Logo    [Settings] [Av]|
+------------------------------------------+    +------------------------+
| h1 Your account        Updated 2 min ago |    | h1 Your account        |
| 128       4,210       4.2%               |    | Updated 2 min ago      |
| posts     followers   engagement (30d)   |    | 128    4,210    4.2%   |
+---------------------------+--------------+    | posts  follow. engage. |
| Recent activity (main)    | Settings     |    +------------------------+
| [N new] pill when live    | (aside, 4/12)|    | Recent activity        |
| 09:41 @ana followed you   | Display name |    | [N new]                |
| 09:12 Post "..." liked    | Email        |    | 09:41 @ana followed    |
| ...                       | Notifications|    | 09:12 Post liked       |
| [Load older]              | [Save]       |    | ...                    |
+---------------------------+--------------+    | [Load older]           |
                                                +------------------------+
Nav flow: any page -> header "Dashboard" -> /dashboard
          /dashboard -> header "Settings" -> /dashboard/settings (375-1023px: own route;
          >=1024px: same content rendered in the aside, link scrolls/focuses it)
```

Constraint worship: if only three things fit, they are the three stat numbers. The header is one row of utility chrome, 56px tall, no imagery, no gradient. The "Updated 2 min ago" timestamp is the only status text in the header.

### D2. Interaction states
What the user SEES per feature. Empty states carry warmth, one primary action, and context.

| FEATURE | LOADING | EMPTY | ERROR | SUCCESS | PARTIAL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stats strip | Three 32px skeleton bars at numeral width; labels render immediately | "0" numerals with label; engagement shows "—" plus "Publish a post to start measuring" | Numerals replaced by "—", one line "Stats unavailable. Retry" link (inline, not toast) | Tabular numerals, no animation on first paint | Any one stat missing shows "—" for that stat only; other two render |
| Activity feed | 5 skeleton rows, 56px each, no shimmer when reduced-motion | Heading "Nothing here yet", body "Activity from your posts and followers lands here", primary button "Write your first post" | Row-list area shows "Couldn't load activity" with "Try again" button; stats and settings unaffected | Rows: time (tabular, left), 16px functional icon, one-line text, 47-char names truncated with ellipsis and full name in title | End of list: "That's everything from the last 30 days"; "Load older" button while more exist |
| Live updates (WebSocket) | Nothing visible; no "connecting" badge | n/a | Inline notice above feed: "Live updates paused. Reconnecting…" then "Live updates off. Refresh to update" after 60s | New items never shift read content; a "3 new" pill appears at feed top, click inserts them and moves focus to first new row | Reconnect replays missed items through the same pill |
| Settings panel | Field skeletons keep label text visible | n/a (fields always exist) | Field-level message below input, red text 16px, tied via aria-describedby; Save stays enabled | "Saved" text beside Save for 4s, no toast, no page jump | Unsaved changes: Save becomes primary, "Unsaved changes" text appears; navigating away prompts |
| Page shell | Header renders synchronously; main region skeletons | n/a | 401: redirect to /login. 500: full-main message "Dashboard unavailable" with Retry; header stays | Normal | Offline: browser offline banner above header, content stays readable |

### D3. User journey storyboard

| STEP | USER DOES | USER FEELS | PLAN SPECIFIES? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Opens /dashboard on phone in the morning | Curious, 5-sec visceral check "how did I do" | D1: three numbers first, nothing above them but a 56px header |
| 2 | Reads stat numbers | Oriented in under 3 seconds | D5: 32px tabular numerals, labels 16px muted |
| 3 | Scans feed | Reassured by recognizable names and times | D2 feed success row spec; D5 icon rules |
| 4 | Sees "3 new" pill, taps | In control, not interrupted | D2 Live updates row |
| 5 | Hits error or loss of connection | Informed, not alarmed | D2 error cells: inline, scoped, actionable |
| 6 | First-time user with zero posts | Welcomed, knows the next action | D2 empty cells: one primary action |
| 7 | Changes a setting | Confident it took | D2 settings success/partial |
| 8 | Returns daily for a year (5-year reflective) | Trusts the numbers | D4: no decoration to date it; D5 tokens hold across themes |

### D4. Specific UI, no slop
- Cardless. Stats, feed, and settings are regions separated by 1px hairline dividers and whitespace, not boxes. Cards appear only if a row becomes the interaction itself (none planned).
- No hero, no gradient, no decorative blobs, no icons in colored circles. Icons are functional only: one 16px monochrome glyph per activity type (follow, like, comment, mention), aria-hidden, always paired with text.
- Copy is utility language: "Recent activity", "Your account", "Load older". No "Welcome to", no mood statements.
- Layout left-aligned throughout; numerals and times tabular. Nothing centered except nothing.
- Motion: one authored moment, the "N new" pill fading in over 160ms ease-out. Skeletons do not shimmer. Honors prefers-reduced-motion.
- Light or dark from the use scene: a creator checking numbers on a phone in daylight. Light is default; dark follows prefers-color-scheme with the same tokens.
- Browser surfaces themed from D5: selection, caret, focus ring, scrollbar thumb, underline offset.

### D5. Tokens (no DESIGN.md exists; these are this plan's inline design system)
- Type: IBM Plex Sans for UI and body (explicitly assigned, Operate surface); IBM Plex Mono for numerals and times with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Scale 16 / 20 / 32px; body never under 16px. h1 20px/600, stat numerals 32px/500, labels 16px muted.
- Color as CSS variables: `--bg`, `--fg`, `--fg-muted`, `--hairline`, `--accent`, `--danger`, `--focus`. Body contrast ≥4.5:1, muted text ≥4.5:1. Muted text on any tinted surface is tinted from that hue, never gray. Accent hue is unresolved (U1); purple/indigo excluded.
- Spacing scale: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48px. More space above a heading (24px) than below (8px).
- Radius: 4px on inputs and buttons only. No shadows; depth comes from hairlines. Focus ring 2px `--focus`, offset 2px.
- Links: underlined, visited color differs from unvisited.

### D6. Responsive and accessibility
- 375px: one column; stats in one row at 32px (fits at 3 × ~110px); settings is its own route; header 56px sticky; touch targets ≥44px; "Load older" full width.
- 768px: one column, max-width 720px, stats row gains labels on the same line as numerals; settings still its own route.
- ≥1024px: 12-column grid, max-width 1200px, feed 8 columns, settings aside 4 columns, sticky aside.
- Landmarks: `header`, `nav`, `main` (feed), `aside` (settings). One h1. Skip link to main.
- Feed is a `ul` with `aria-live="polite"` on the "N new" pill only, not the list. Each row is a link with the full text as its name; `time` elements carry `datetime`.
- Settings: visible labels above fields, never placeholder-as-label; errors tied via aria-describedby; Save reachable by Tab in order.
- Keyboard: all actions on Tab order, visible focus per D5, Escape dismisses the unsaved-changes prompt.

## NOT in scope
- Charts or sparklines for stats: numbers alone meet the 3-second scan; add only once a trend question is validated.
- Notification center or unread badges: the feed and "N new" pill cover this.
- Theming beyond light/dark system preference: no user theme picker.
- Avatar upload inside settings: separate upload flow with its own states.

## What already exists
- No DESIGN.md referenced by the plan; D5 stands in until `/design-consultation` produces one.
- Tailwind is already the styling layer; D5 tokens map to theme extensions, no new dependency.
- Existing auth redirect to /login is assumed and reused for the 401 state (verify in app shell).

## TODOS.md updates
Approved fixes are implementation tasks below, not TODOs. One deferred item proposed:
- **What:** Create DESIGN.md from D5 tokens via `/design-consultation`. **Why:** Three future surfaces will otherwise re-derive tokens. **Pros:** One vocabulary for plans and code. **Cons:** ~1h of decisions including accent hue (U1). **Context:** This plan carries tokens inline because no system existed on 2026-10-04. **Depends on:** U1. Options: A) Add to TODOS.md (recommended) B) Skip C) Build now. Pending user choice.

## Implementation Tasks
Synthesized from this review's findings. Each task derives from a specific finding above. Run with Claude Code or Codex; checkbox as you ship.

- [ ] **T1 (P1, human: ~1d / CC: ~20min)** — Dashboard shell — Build header, grid, and landmarks per D1 and D6
  - Surfaced by: Pass 1 — no hierarchy, hero on an Operate surface
  - Files: src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, src/components/AppHeader.tsx
  - Verify: axe has 0 landmark/heading violations; 375/768/1024 screenshots match D1 diagram

  - Verify: Storybook story per state cell; mock API for empty, 500, partial

  - Surfaced by: Pass 2 and Pass 3 step 4

- [ ] **T4 (P1, human: ~4h / CC: ~10min)** — Tokens — Define D5 CSS variables in Tailwind theme, theme browser surfaces per D4
  - Surfaced by: Pass 4 and Pass 5

  - Verify: contrast check on all text pairs ≥4.5:1; no hex literals in components
- [ ] **T5 (P2, human: ~4h / CC: ~10min)** — Responsive and a11y — Breakpoint behavior and keyboard paths per D6
  - Surfaced by: Pass 6

  - Verify: keyboard-only walkthrough; touch targets ≥44px at 375px; reduced-motion disables pill fade
